status_detail: Missoula County project page says the proposed data center at 9314 Bonner Miller Road would start around 7 MW and could expand to 29 MW, but an update says property owner Mike Heisey withdrew his signature and the project will not move forward.
notes: Official county engagement page provides location, special-exception review status, capacity range and withdrawal update. County also adopted a one-year moratorium on new/expanded data centers outside city limits effective July 9, 2026 to July 8, 2027.

status_detail: Former cryptocurrency mining/data center operation at Bonner Industrial Park; local reporting says it opened in 2016/2017, used about 20 MW, expansion was halted after county regulations, and it closed/folded in 2020.
notes: Included as a historical/closed facility because it is repeatedly cited in Missoula County data-center zoning history. Status enum has no closed value, so status is unknown with closure described in status_detail.
